biotools.summary: gReLU is a software framework for DNA sequence modeling and design, enabling pipelines including data preprocessing, modeling, evaluation, interpretation, variant effect prediction, and regulatory element design.  It provides tools for advanced sequence modeling using deep learning approaches.
